create_Voxelizer_with_augmentation: create a Voxelizer instance with voxel size, clip bounds, and data augmentation settings for point cloud processing
run_Voxelizer_voxelize: run the Voxelizer voxelize method to convert 3D coordinates, features, labels, and instances into sparse voxel grid format
run_Voxelizer_voxelize_temporal: run the Voxelizer voxelize_temporal method to voxelize multiple timesteps of point cloud data with shared transformation matrices
test_Voxelizer_clip: test the Voxelizer clip method to filter 3D coordinates within specified bounding box limits with optional translation augmentation
review_Voxelizer_get_transformation_matr: review the Voxelizer get_transformation_matrix method that computes rotation and scale matrices for point cloud coordinate transformation
